items.q: Alto and C melody, like Frankie Trumbauer played C melody. That was a popular instrument then. So he went away and as I said, he brought me this saxophone back

ctx.x: This was alto. Alto was a popular instrument then. There weren't many tenor players, you know. It just wasn't a popular instrument at that time. Alto and C melody, like Frankie Trumbauer played C melody. That was a popular instrument then.

So he went away and as I said, he brought me this saxophone back and there was a fella there that played saxophone and trumpet by the name of Emmett Malone, He was a very advanced musician. He just had talent because he was way ahead of time, really. It's too bad he didn't pursue
